name: Blood of the Dragon
source:
Yearning to prove yourself, you train to become a knight's squire. After finally besting your mentor, your village is attacked, unlocking a dormant power within your blood. After successfully defending your home, you travel to the capital to seek answers about your origin. An answer which will change the entire kingdom forever.
